The '''Belvaria system''' was located in the [[Corweillian sector/Legends|Corweillian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Insect/Legends|insects]] known as [[Belvarian firegnat]]s.<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Belvaria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-15.<ref name="TEA" />
